primary.coast_angle: Equilibrium hinge fold angle, measured by hinge rotary encoder; zero is the unfolded hinge reference (coplanar tip/inner wing for the untwisted configuration).
primary.positive_beta: Reduces port effective flare and increases starboard effective flare.
primary.effective_flare_for_port_deg: Lambda-beta, subject to consistent primary beta convention; Eq7.3 Lambda+beta is the starboard expression.
primary.physical_encoder_vs_sensor_bank: Encoder hinge angle is not generally the same as an Euler bank/roll angle of a sensor frame at finite flare/fold. The archived Var5 sign choice alone does not resolve this mismatch.

conventions.candidate: ASW body convention is x aft, y starboard, z up (theory Fig2/Eq1). Source joint1/beam2 y>0 is starboard, joint2/beam3 y<0 is port. With gravity toward -z, positive upward fold is q1 on starboard and -q2 on port.
conventions.sensor_relation: For level rigid parent and horizontal unit hinge axis h, Phi=atan2(-h_x sin(q),cos(q)); Theta is elevation. General Phi=atan2(-S_zy,S_zz) for exported sensor triad S in Earth axes.
conventions.rotation_crosscheck: q=atan2(h dot vee(R-R.T)/2,(trace(R)-1)/2), R=parent.T@tip. Law q must agree without modulo reduction.

primary_pose_and_gravity.facility: University of Bristol 7ft by5ft low-speed closed-return wind tunnel
primary_pose_and_gravity.mount: Six-component overhead balance with rear strut; model incidence and sideslip varied physically.
primary_pose_and_gravity.gravity: Laboratory vertical; physically changing model incidence changes gravity expressed in body coordinates. Exact balance Euler rotation sequence is not specified here.
primary_pose_and_gravity.zero_flow_reference: Wingtip points vertically down at zero flow; used as the author continuation starting solution.
primary_pose_and_gravity.gravity_value_note: Primary chapters inspected do not give a measured local value. Archive ASW uses9.81.
primary_pose_and_gravity.density_note: No matched experimental density/temperature/pressure recovered from the mapped sections. Archive1.2256 is a model constant, not a verified test-density measurement.

local_flow_offsets.use_in_primary_model: Author says Table7.1 defines numerical onset flow.
local_flow_offsets.scope: These local-tip corrections are reported at22m/s. Their validity throughout12–33m/s sweeps or at all model attitudes is not established by this table.

documentation.claim: Sensor axes, Phi roll, Theta elevation; induced flow.
Euler attitude sets body gravity direction.
ASW body-frame geometry, positive freestream opposite aircraft velocity, z up.
Encoders, incidence protocol, local-flow offsets, nominal port measurements, fold and sideslip conventions.

limitations: This is a conditional nominal-protocol comparison, not an experimental accuracy acceptance or original ASWING parity claim.

Primary nominal zero follows the documented 3 degree incidence protocol. CSV x values remain -0.1693206314, -0.2429131029, -0.1083605683 degrees; they are digitized figure coordinates, not recovered exact operating-angle measurements, and are not interpolated.
Nominal beta0 follows the frozen primary mapping and incidence-sweep baseline context. No per-point actual body attitude or local flow-angle record is supplied.
Uniform candidate true speed22/alpha0/beta0 and level pose do not include Table7.1 local port flow offsets +1.2m/s,-0.8deg,-2deg or starboard +1.2m/s,-1.8deg,+0.7deg.

Laboratory gravity is vertical. Model incidence/sideslip were physically varied; exact mounting alignment/rotation sequence is unavailable. Level attitude at nominal zero is an explicit candidate assumption.
Candidate Earth/body gravity at zero pose is [0,0,-9.81] in ASWING conventions (theory Eq206); primary body-frame z-down convention must not be substituted directly.
Density1.2256 and g9.81 come from the literal model/standard-atmosphere defaults, not matched measured tunnel conditions.

Primary hinge .365m, tip CG .4243m, mass .061kg and chordwise CG -.0139m differ from archive hinge .364m, uniform tip CG .432m, mass .0614584kg; only Flare20 port has Ccg-.013m. No correction or calibration applied.
The literal reconstruction is rigid; primary inner wing flexure, friction and contact are not reconstructed. The free hinge is represented by the finite archived approximately1e-6Nm/rad spring.

Cold load homotopy from the jig does not reproduce author continuation from a vertically hanging zero-flow solution; no loaded branch stability proof is supplied. Flare10 reuses the99module fixed-four-step candidate; failed20/30 controls are retained and retried with the101module reviewed adaptive-continuation candidate.
Requested100/40/40 discretization realizes187nodes/184elements here; archived actual ASWING grid, executable, wake/core/stall/PG settings and startup files are unavailable. No mesh convergence claim.
Archived row7 asks alpha-0.1693206314 for all flares; beta and early point constraints are not established. Its bank output is retained as contextual evidence only.

Hinge encoder angle, sensor Phi bank and sensor Theta elevation are distinct. Longitudinal MATLAB uses+Phi2 on port; sideslip/twist uses-Phi3 on starboard. No side conversion is inferred from a sign alone. The rotation/law check tolerance1e-6deg is solely a numerical identity check, not an experimental acceptance tolerance.
No pointwise measurement/digitization uncertainty is available; decimal precision is not an accuracy bound. No fit, interpolation, uncertainty band or pass threshold is manufactured.
